note: Linear in payload length over the range that completes. With 8 in-flight slots, eight large requests hold the gateway for the duration of the slowest and every real customer gets a 429.
second_finding: Past roughly 8,000 characters the guard does not merely slow down, it STOPS WORKING - the local model drops the connection. So the 4,000-character limit is not performance tuning; it is what keeps the guard functional. A size limit placed for latency reasons turned out to be load-bearing for correctness.
